title: 332章 先擒凶悖，帝心制衡
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

雷霆一喝落庭中，整座贝勒府的杀气与刀光，瞬间凝固。

努尔哈赤踏步而入，龙威如山，压得满院甲兵喘不过气。

此时褚英虽酒醒大半，狼狈僵立当场，可他身后随行的正白旗巴牙喇依旧甲刃在手、列阵护主。一旦处置过激，顷刻便是旗兵哗变、后金内战的滔天祸乱。

久经风浪的努尔哈赤目光一扫，便压住了满院躁动，不审罪、不怒骂、不妄开杀戒，只沉喝一声：

“所有正白旗随扈，即刻弃刃跪地！”

君威如铁，不容半分违抗。

一众正白旗武士本就心虚胆寒，此刻听闻大汗口谕，无人再敢持刃对峙。铿锵脆响接连不绝，无数长刀坠地，所有亲兵尽数弃甲跪伏，再无半分戾气。

待到全场兵器尽敛、局势彻底可控，努尔哈赤才冷眸落于身败名裂的褚英身上，淡淡吐出一句：

“逆子放肆，拿下！”

两黄旗精锐一拥而上，当场扣锁褚英双臂，将这位曾经的后金储君、广略贝勒死死摁压在地。

褚英浑身僵硬，血色尽数褪去，纵有万般桀骜蛮横，此刻在父汗滔天君威与层层重兵合围之下，彻底无力挣扎。

努尔哈赤冷眼扫视全场，不多言一字，只沉声传令：

“带回禁足，不许私见一人，静待发落！”

他深谙帝王权术，从不在兵变未平之际当场定死死罪。

先控人、再稳局、后清算，方能绝后患、安人心、稳宗室。

当夜，汗宫旨意遍传八旗。

第一道汗谕，直指褚英。

废黜褚英一切储君名分，剥夺所有兵权、旗权与议政资格。即日起锁禁私府，闭门思过，终身不得干政、不得私见旧部、不得触碰寸兵寸权。

死罪虽免，但其毕生权力、前途、霸业、威望，尽数清零。

第二道汗谕，铁血肃正军纪。

今日随同褚英闯府闹事、持刀对峙、纵容兵卒施暴的正白旗巴牙喇带头头目，尽数捉拿，即刻枭首示众，传首九门！

其余盲从兵卒，各施重刑，贬秩流放，以正旗规，以儆效尤。

第三道汗谕，彻底拆解祸乱根源。

褚英执掌正白旗，滋生悖逆、祸乱宗藩，罪孽根植于旗中。即日起，正白旗所有牛录、部众、兵丁尽数打散拆分，编入其余七旗整编消化，旧正白旗建制彻底作废，永不复用。

一刀斩断褚英所有嫡系根基，自此世间再无褚英私党。

旨意既出，后金朝野震动，宗室诸贝勒、八旗勋贵无人敢有半句非议。

紧接着，努尔哈赤再下新令，抽调七旗忠勇精锐，重建全新正白旗。

文武贝勒尽皆瞩目之际，努尔哈赤当众点将：

“新正白旗旗务兵马，暂由皇太极统管节制。”

此言一出，庭中人心尽知。

两黄旗直属汗王，余下正白旗便是暗中默认的储君之旗。大汗此举，无异于昭告八旗内外——皇太极，已是后金默许的储贰人选。

可立于下方的皇太极，心性深沉、洞明世事，当即躬身叩首，姿态极尽恭谨，言辞恳切推让：

“父汗！万万不可。”

“大兄新遭重罚，儿臣若贸然接手大兄旧旗，外则招致宗室非议，内则有伤手足伦常。儿臣宁愿无权一身轻，也不愿担此嫌疑，更不愿借父兄之过攫取权位。”

“儿臣资质浅薄，恐不堪一旗重担，恳请父汗另择贤能！”

皇太极字字赤诚、句句退让，不争权、不贪位、避嫌疑、守孝道。

他最懂人心、最懂朝堂声名。越是推让，越显无私；越是不敢承接，越配身居储位。

努尔哈赤静静目视他良久，眼底暗藏赞许，赞许此子心性隐忍、城府深沉，随即沉声开口，以君命强行定音：

“汝心可嘉，汝情可悯。”

“但私恩小义，不敌大金江山大业。”

“国基初立，基业未稳，旗权不可悬空，宗室格局不可失衡。此事非你不可，为建州、为八旗、为万世基业，你必须担下此任，不必辞，亦不许辞。”

Page (1/3)

As soon as the thunderbolt fell into the courtyard, the murderous aura and sword light in the entire Baylor Mansion instantly froze.

Nurhachi stepped in, the dragon was as powerful as a mountain, and the soldiers in the courtyard couldn't breathe.

Although Chu Ying was mostly sober at this time and stood there in a panic, the Zhengbai Banner Ba Yala accompanying him still had his armor in hand and formed a formation to protect the Lord.Once the handling is excessive, it will immediately lead to the rebellion of the banner soldiers and the civil war of the Later Jin Dynasty.

Nurhachi, who had experienced many storms, suppressed the restlessness in the courtyard with a glance. He did not judge the crime, cursed, or killed indiscriminately. He only shouted:

"All retinue of Zhengbai Banner, immediately abandon their swords and kneel down!"

The king's power is as strong as iron and cannot be disobeyed in the slightest.

The Zhengbai Banner warriors were already guilty and timid, but now that they heard the Great Khan's words, no one dared to confront them with their swords.There were clanging sounds one after another, and countless long knives fell to the ground. All the soldiers abandoned their armor and knelt down, without any trace of violence.

When all the weapons in the audience were gathered and the situation was completely under control, Nurhachi turned his cold eyes on the ruined Chu Ying and said lightly:

"The traitor is so impudent, take it down!"

The two yellow flag elites swarmed forward, locked Chu Ying's arms on the spot, and pinned the former heir to the Jin Dynasty, Guangluo Baylor, to the ground.

Chu Ying's whole body was stiff, and all his blood had faded. Even though he was so unruly and arrogant, he was completely unable to struggle under the overwhelming majesty of his father Khan and the surrounding layers of heavy soldiers.

Nurhachi glanced at the audience coldly, without saying a word, and only gave the order in a deep voice:

"Bring him back to the ground, don't allow him to meet anyone privately, and wait for his fate!"

He was well versed in imperial power and never sentenced anyone to death on the spot while the rebellion was still pending.

Only by controlling people first, then stabilizing the situation, and then liquidating can we avoid future troubles, reassure people, and stabilize the clan.

That night, the decree of the Khan Palace spread throughout the Eight Banners.

The first edict was directed at Chu Ying.

Deposed Chu Ying from all titles as prince, deprived of all military power, flag power and political qualifications.From now on, he will be locked up in his private residence and ponder his faults behind closed doors. He will not be allowed to interfere in politics, nor will he have any private views on his old subordinates, nor will he touch even an inch of military power for the rest of his life.

Although he is exempted from the death penalty, his lifelong power, future, dominance and prestige will all be wiped out.

The second Khan's edict was to enforce military discipline with iron blood.

Today, he accompanied Chu Ying to cause trouble in the mansion, held a knife confrontation, and allowed the soldiers to commit violence. He took the lead in arresting all the leaders, and immediately showed their heads to the public and sent them to the nine gates!

The rest blindly followed the soldiers, and each of them was severely punished, demoted and exiled, in order to set the standard and standard as a warning.

The third edict completely dismantled the root cause of the disaster.

Chu Ying was in charge of the Zhengbai Banner, breeding rebellion and bringing trouble to the sect and vassal, and sin was deeply rooted in the flag.From now on, all the Niulu, tribesmen and soldiers of Zhengbai Banner will be broken up and divided into the remaining seven banners for reorganization and digestion. The old Zhengbai Banner organization will be completely abolished and will never be used again.

Cut off all the foundations of Chu Ying's direct lineage with one stroke, and there will be no more private parties of Chu Ying in the world.

As soon as the decree came out, the Jin Dynasty and the public were shocked. No one in the imperial clan or the Eight Banners dared to criticize it.

Immediately afterwards, Nurhachi issued a new order to mobilize the loyal and brave elite of the Seven Banners to rebuild a new Zhengbai Banner.

With all the civil and military personnel paying attention, Nurhachi ordered his generals in public:

"The new Zhengbai Banner and its troops and horses are temporarily under the control of Huang Taiji."

As soon as this statement came out, everyone in the court knew it.

The two yellow flags belong directly to the Khan, and the remaining white flag is the secret flag of the prince.The Great Khan's move was tantamount to telling everyone inside and outside the Eight Banners that Huang Taiji was already the tacitly approved candidate for the throne of the Later Jin Dynasty.

But Huang Taiji, who was standing below, had a deep mind and a clear understanding of the world. He immediately bowed and kowtowed, his posture was extremely respectful, and his words were sincere:

"Father! You must not do this."

"The eldest brother has been severely punished. If I rashly take over the old banner of my eldest brother, I will cause criticism from the clan externally and damage the sibling ethics internally. I would rather have no power and live lightly than bear this suspicion, let alone seize power through the mistakes of my father and brother."

"My son's qualifications are shallow and he may not be able to bear the heavy responsibility of one banner. I sincerely ask my father to choose someone more capable!"

Huang Taiji is sincere in every word, gives in every word, does not fight for power, is not greedy for position, avoids suspicion, and observes filial piety.

He understands people's hearts and reputation best.The more you give in, the more selfless you are; the more you dare not accept, the more worthy you are of being in the reserve position.

Nurhachi looked at him quietly for a long time, with hidden approval in his eyes. He praised this son for his forbearance and deep character. Then he spoke in a deep voice and forcibly settled the voice with your order:

"Your heart is commendable and your sentiments are pitiable."

"But personal favors and small righteousness are not as good as the great wealth and great undertakings."

"The foundation of the country has just been established, but the foundation is not stable. The flag power cannot be left vacant, and the clan structure cannot be unbalanced. This matter must be done by you. For the founding of the state, the Eight Banners, and the eternal foundation, you must take on this responsibility. There is no need to resign, and you are not allowed to resign."
